property.name: Bond Address
property.description: IP or hostname of the Bond Bridge or Smart by Bond device. A bare IP is fine; anything pasted after the host is ignored. The Bond must be reachable from this controller. One driver instance per Bond unit.

property.name: Local Token
property.description: The Bond's local API token, from the Bond Home app: select the Bond, Settings gear, Advanced, Local Token. Stored encrypted on the controller and cleared from this field once saved - an empty field after pasting means it was accepted. Alternative: power-cycle the Bond and run Fetch Token From Bond within 10 minutes.

property.name: Discovered Bonds
property.description: Bonds heard on the network via mDNS, as id @ address. Searched automatically at startup and by the Discover Bonds On Network action. While the Bond Address is still the install default, the first Bond heard fills it in automatically; a configured gateway is never re-pointed.

property.name: Bond PIN
property.description: Alternative pairing path: the PIN printed on the Bond unit itself. Stored encrypted, cleared from this field once saved, and deleted after it has unlocked a token. After setting it, run Fetch Token From Bond.

property.name: Device Poll Interval
property.description: How often the device list and states are checked over HTTP. Cheap: one request answers whether anything changed at all. Push updates (BPUP) deliver state changes immediately regardless; polling is the safety net. Off disables polling; Test Connection and Sync Devices Now still work.

property.name: Push Updates
property.description: Subscribes to the Bond's push protocol (BPUP, UDP port 30007) so device state lands immediately - a fan speed changed from the factory remote shows in Navigator without waiting for a poll. Push Status shows whether the subscription is delivering.

property.name: Driver Version
property.description: The build actually running on this instance. If this does not match the newest build after an update, the project is serving a cached copy of the driver.

property.name: Connection Status
property.default: Not configured - set the Bond Address and Local Token

property.name: Scenes
property.description: Bond scenes discovered on this unit (built in the Bond Home app). Run them from programming with the Run Bond Scene command.

property.name: Push Status
property.description: Whether BPUP push updates are flowing. Delivering means state changes arrive immediately; Waiting means subscribed but nothing heard yet; polling covers either way.

property.name: License Status
property.description: This driver's standing with the SmartBuildOS Agent in this project, as one line. Everything keeps working while licensing rolls out.

property.name: License Source
property.description: How this driver is licensed: included with the company's SmartBuildOS subscription, or purchased outright (perpetual). Answered by the SmartBuildOS Agent.

property.name: Subscription Tier
property.description: The SmartBuildOS subscription tier of the company this driver is licensed under, as reported by the SmartBuildOS Agent.

property.name: SmartBuildOS Company
property.description: The registered SmartBuildOS company this driver is associated with, as reported by the SmartBuildOS Agent.

command.name: Run Bond Scene
command.description: Run Bond scene SCENE (by name or id, as built in the Bond Home app)

command.name: Run Bond Action
command.description: Run Bond action ACTION on device DEVICE with optional ARGUMENT (advanced - argument may be a number or JSON)
